# look
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package look holds the few pieces of Bubble 4 that MUSA's screens need and bubble/goui does not give yet: a card, a page's header, a figure with its label, a pill and an empty state. Each one is drawn the way Bubble's showcase draws it (bubble/goui/cmd/showcase), only from the theme's tokens, so swapping a piece for Bubble's own, once it has it, changes no screen. TODO(akrck02): ask the Bubble session to move these into bubble/goui, then use them from there.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `const PageMotion = 240 * time.Millisecond ...` | How long things take to move, as Bubble moves them: quick for what answers a touch, a little longer for what arrives, and quicker to leave than to come. |
| `const PageRise = 10 ...` | How far things travel as they come, in pixels: a page rises a little, a dialog a little more. |
| `const HoverDarkening = 0.15` | HoverDarkening is how much ink a button on a colour takes under the pointer. |
| `const Unsynced = "Sin sincronizar"` | Unsynced is what a page synced with an outside service says while it is not connected to one. |
| `var PageTitle = HeaderSize{ ... } ...` | PageTitle is the header of most pages; Greeting is the home page's, a little bigger. |
| `var Halves = SegmentSize{ ... } ...` | Halves are the segments that split a page in two big halves («Físico», «Digital»); Views are the smaller ones that switch a page's view («Resumen», «Calendario»). |
| `var GroupTabs = PillSize{ ... }` | GroupTabs are the tabs of the groups of a list («Todo», «Láminas»…). |
| `var LargeTabs = PillSize{ ... }` | LargeTabs are the tabs a page is browsed by, big for a quick finger: the stand's. |
| `func Across(context *ui.Context) ui.Direction` | Across is the direction of a row that holds words and their actions: side by side on a wide window, the actions under the words on a phone, where long names would run into them. |
| `func Answering(theme ui.Theme, normal, hovered ui.Look) ui.Looks` | Answering are a button's looks from its look at rest and under the pointer: its border, or its fill when it has none, turns a shade deeper when hovered and deeper still when pressed, so it answers the finger in its own colour. |
| `func Arriving(look ui.Look, shown, rise float32) ui.Look` | Arriving is a look on its way in: shown goes from 0 (not yet) to 1 (there), as Context.Appear gives it; until then the box is see-through and lower by part of rise. |
| `func AtMost(context *ui.Context, pixels float32) ui.Sizing` | AtMost is a width of pixels when the page has room for it, and the whole page's width when it does not: a column designed for a laptop that a phone narrows instead of cutting. |
| `func Badge(context *ui.Context, icon string, size float32)` | Badge is an icon in a soft round patch of the accent, the picture of a place or an action. |
| `func Card(context *ui.Context, layout ui.Layout, content func())` | Card is Bubble's card on paper: the surface, a fine line around it and the panels' corners. |
| `func CentredParagraph(context *ui.Context, text string, style ui.TextStyle)` | CentredParagraph is a Paragraph whose lines stand in the middle of its box. |
| `func ClickableCard(context *ui.Context, label string, layout ui.Layout, content func()) bool` | ClickableCard is a Card the whole of which is one button, which a screen reader calls label; it returns true on the frame it is clicked. |
| `func Columns(context *ui.Context, wanted int) int` | Columns is how many columns a grid of wanted columns gets: on a phone, half of them, at least one. |
| `func Dark(theme ui.Theme) bool` | Dark tells whether the theme is a dark one, from how light its background is. |
| `func Empty(context *ui.Context, icon, title, message, action string) bool` | Empty fills a page with nothing to show yet: an icon, a title, a line of help and, when action is not empty, a button; it returns true on the frame that button is clicked. |
| `func Field(context *ui.Context, label, name string, text *string, ...) bool` | Field is a labelled text field: the label small and bold above it, and, when problem is not empty, the problem under it in the danger colour. |
| `func Figure(context *ui.Context, label, value string, negative bool)` | Figure is one number of a summary: its label, small and soft, above it in bold. |
| `func Figures(context *ui.Context, count int, figures func())` | Figures is one quiet card holding a row of figures, so a summary reads as one thing rather than a wall of boxes. |
| `func Label(context *ui.Context, title string)` | Label is the small, soft title of a group: a section, or a part of a list. |
| `func Leaving(rise float32) ui.Leave` | Leaving is how a dialog or a floating bar goes when it is no longer shown: it fades as it sinks. |
| `func Link(context *ui.Context, words string) bool` | Link is words that act, small, bold and underlined, for an action inside a sentence or a note («Ver cuáles»). |
| `func MainButton(context *ui.Context, icon, words string) bool` | MainButton is a page's main action: its icon and words on the accent. |
| `func Meter(context *ui.Context, done, whole int)` | Meter is a thin bar of how much of a whole is done: units sold of those taken. |
| `func Narrow(context *ui.Context) bool` | Narrow tells whether the window is phone-sized. |
| `func PageHeader(context *ui.Context, title, subtitle string, actions func())` | PageHeader is the top of a page: its title and a soft line under it on the left, and the page's actions on the right, standing on the same line as the bottom of the words (actions may be nil). |
| `func Paragraph(context *ui.Context, text string, style ui.TextStyle)` | Paragraph writes text that breaks into lines to fit its box, word by word: go-ui's Text keeps one line. |
| `func Pill(context *ui.Context, text string, tone Tone)` | Pill is a short label in a rounded well of its tone. |
| `func PillTabs(context *ui.Context, name string, selected *int, tabs []Tab, size PillSize) bool` | PillTabs is a row of quiet tabs where the chosen one stands in a pill with a fine line: the groups of a list («Todo», «Láminas»…). |
| `func QuietLink(context *ui.Context, words string, size, lineHeight float32) bool` | QuietLink is soft, underlined words that act, of a size and a line height, under a name («Cambiar»). |
| `func SearchButton(context *ui.Context, search *Search)` | SearchButton is the round button that opens the search, or closes it and forgets what was typed. |
| `func SearchField(context *ui.Context, search *Search, placeholder string)` | SearchField is the search's field while the search is open; nothing while it is closed. |
| `func Section(context *ui.Context, title string, content func())` | Section is one part of a form or a detail page: a small, soft title above a card, so the content leads and the titles stay out of its way. |
| `func Segmented(context *ui.Context, name string, selected *int, tabs []Tab, size SegmentSize) bool` | Segmented is a track with a raised, lit choice: the halves of a page, or its views. |
| `func SizedPageHeader(context *ui.Context, title, subtitle string, size HeaderSize, actions func())` | SizedPageHeader is PageHeader with words of another size. |
| `func Space(context *ui.Context, pixels float32)` | Space is an empty gap of pixels between the things above and below it, or before and after. |
| `func SyncStatus(context *ui.Context, words string)` | SyncStatus is a soft line that says how a page stands with the outside service it copies (Trello, a shop): a circling arrow and words. |
| `func ToolButton(context *ui.Context, icon, label string) bool` | ToolButton is a square button with only an icon, on the surface with a fine line, for a page's tools (searching); a screen reader calls it label. |
| `func Wide(context *ui.Context) bool` | Wide tells whether the window is wide enough for two panes side by side. |
| `type Corner int` | Corner names one corner of a box, for Corners. |
| `const TopLeft Corner = 1 << iota ...` | The corners of a box, as flags that can be added: TopLeft \| BottomRight. |
| `type Corners struct{ ... }` | Corners paints a box's fill with only some of its corners rounded: the cell in a corner of a rounded table, which CSS would cut with the table's overflow. |
| `type Fade struct{ ... }` | Fade paints a box from clear at its top to Colour further down, as CSS's linear-gradient(transparent, colour Solid%) does: what scrolls under it melts into the page instead of meeting a hard edge. |
| `type HeaderSize struct{ ... }` | HeaderSize is how big a page header's title and subtitle are, in pixels. |
| `type PillSize struct{ ... }` | PillSize is how big the tabs of a row of PillTabs are. |
| `type Search struct{ ... }` | Search is a search a page opens from a button: whether its field shows, and what is typed in it. |
| `type SegmentSize struct{ ... }` | SegmentSize is how big a Segmented track and its choices are, in pixels. |
| `type Tab struct{ ... }` | Tab is one choice of a row of tabs: an optional icon, its words and an optional count. |
| `type Tone struct{ ... }` | Tone is the colours of a pill. |
| `func Danger(theme ui.Theme) Tone` | Danger is the tone of something wrong now, such as a sold-out product. |
| `func Neutral(theme ui.Theme) Tone` | Neutral is the tone of a pill that only informs: the sunken well and the soft ink. |
| `func Positive(theme ui.Theme) Tone` | Positive is the tone of something going well, such as stock to spare. |
| `func Warning(theme ui.Theme) Tone` | Warning is the tone of something that needs care soon, such as low stock. |
| `type TopRounded struct{ ... }` | TopRounded paints a box's fill with only its upper corners rounded: a picture at the top of a card, whose lower edge meets the card's words. |
